'''bmackin13 ROps Version 2''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[bmackin13]]
* '''Published:''' 10 July 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif|label=Ralltiir Operations}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Ralltiir Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 ROps bmackin13 DS 2004 5718.txt|Download]] (omits Ability, Ability, Ability (V), Imperial-Class Star Destroyer (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

A ROps deck helped along by cam solusar, thanks.

== Notes ==

* Second version of the author's ROps list (first version GPN 5710).
* Posted Colonel David Jon dested Colonel Davod Jon; Lieutenant Commander Arden dested Lieutenant Commander Ardan; Go For Help dested Go For Help!; Accelerate dested the Interrupt Accelerate.
* Original-era (V) cards: Imperial-Class Star Destroyer (V) (Virtual Set 2), Ability, Ability, Ability (V) (Virtual Set 6).

== Strategy ==

Get Rendili with Mob. Points and deploy first turn.  2 icons for you, one for them, and they only force drain for 1.  Use ROps to deploy sites first, then non-unique imperials(biker scouts).  Use bikers to get speeder bikes from reserve deck.  Get Palpy and Overseeing It Personally out ASAP for better force drains.  Control both Rendili and Ralltiir, Rendili for a battleground syatem to get around Battle Plan and Raltiir to use Fighter Cover.  React around with bikes as needed.  Protect Ralltiir and dont let ITHOTE get flipped back to ROps.
